versions.changelog:
Shipp 0.1.4

- Added explicit mention of API key requirement in compatibility requirements (now lists "Shipp API Key" and where to get it).
- Minor clarifications throughout docs and usage examples.
- Improved documentation for the example "Alph Bot" project and updated its integration description.
- No breaking changes to endpoints, schema, or functionality.

shipp 0.1.3

- Updated version to 0.1.3.
- Added a README.md file.
- Expanded allowed Bash(curl) tool access to all major shipp.ai domains.
- Enhanced usage tips for working with schema-flexible event data, polling, and deduplication.
- Added an “Integration Pattern: Real-Time Contract” section to guide robust feature design.
- Included an example project (Alph Bot) to illustrate production-quality Shipp API integration.

- Updated compatibility requirements: removed the explicit mention of "Shipp API Key" as a requirement.
- Added a link to create an API key for Shipp.ai in the introduction.
- Minor edit to the project description to link to Shipp.ai homepage.
- No changes to endpoints, error handling, or usage details.
- No functional or structural changes to the skill code itself.
Update format and improve authorization handling

Initial release of Shipp real-time data connector.

- Provides access to real-time, authoritative external data via the Shipp API.
- Supports reusable live feed creation and execution with natural-language filters.
- Enables one-off sports schedule lookups without set-up.
- Requires internet access and an API key for all endpoints.
- Includes safety and autonomy guidelines for data use and API interaction.
